guarantees.claim: ctr_we_o_rev is driven combinatorially: all bits are set to {NumSlicesCtr{SP2V_LOW}}, then ctr_we_o_rev[ctr_slice_idx] is set to ctr_we.

assumptions.claim: ctr_slice_idx must be less than NumSlicesCtr (valid index).
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds bit access may cause undefined simulation behavior or synthesis mismatch.

uncertain_points.claim: If NumSlicesCtr can be zero, the bit assignment ctr_we_o_rev[ctr_slice_idx] is an out-of-bounds access because ctr_we_o_rev has no bits.
uncertain_points.risk: Simulation errors, synthesis warnings, or undriven logic.
